title: Rajasthan State Eligibility Test SET Admit Card 2026
vacancyDetails: Eligibility examination for Assistant Professor eligibility; this is not a direct recruitment vacancy count.
qualification: Candidates enrolled for Rajasthan SET 2026 should verify the subject and examination eligibility in the official notice.
ageLimit: No upper age limit for Rajasthan SET; check the official notice for examination conditions.
selectionProcess: SET Paper I and Paper II examination for eligibility certification as notified by UOK.
documentsRequired: Admit card, application details and a valid photo identity proof as required at the examination centre.
howToApply:
1. Open the official UOK SET notice or candidate portal
2. Select the Rajasthan SET Admit Card 2026 link
3. Use Server I or Server II and enter the required login details
4. Download and check the name, subject, centre and examination instructions
5. Print the admit card and carry the required photo identity proof
shortDescription: University of Kota has issued the Rajasthan State Eligibility Test SET Admit Card 2026 update. Candidates enrolled in Rajasthan SET 2026 can use the official admit-card servers and read the latest notice before appearing for the examination.
content:
University of Kota (UOK) has published the Rajasthan State Eligibility Test (SET) 2026 admit-card update for enrolled candidates. Download the admit card only through the official Rajasthan recruitment or SSO login service.

Check the candidate name, subject, examination centre, reporting instructions and identity-proof requirements before travelling to the centre. The official UOK notice remains final for the examination schedule and download process.
editorNotes: Admit-card update created from the supplied UOK and Rajasthan recruitment links. Verify the live candidate portal and latest UOK notice before publishing changes.
importantInstructions: Use only the official recruitment.rajasthan.gov.in, sso.rajasthan.gov.in or uok.ac.in links. Do not share login credentials or OTPs.

faqs.question: Who can download the Rajasthan SET Admit Card 2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates enrolled for Rajasthan SET 2026 should use the official admit-card server and candidate login details.

faqs.question: Which website publishes the Rajasthan SET admit-card notice?
faqs.answer: Check the University of Kota SET Examination page linked in the Important Links section.

faqs.question: What should candidates carry to the examination centre?
faqs.answer: Carry a printed admit card and the valid photo identity proof required by the official examination instructions.
